name: Trading Capacity 5 Code
definition: Specifies the role of a trading party in a transaction.

RISP.name: Riskless Principal
RISP.definition: Trading as a riskless principal, ie, the order to buy(sell) has been simultaneously offset by an order to sell (buy) with another party.

AGEN.name: Agent
AGEN.definition: Trading as Agent on behalf of a customer.
